Fixture 68: Mask Border, Regions, and Shapes Inside

The 26 properties of the v0.0.3 mask-border, regions, and shapes ledgers · descriptor, flow, and line-inset effects · font-family "Liberation Sans"

MASK-BORDER-REGIONS-SHAPES

One row per property, in three sections. The mask-border section records the frame on the element's blend group and paints no pixels here (the host applies the mask), so its effect cells show the declaration and the resolved shape of the data. The regions and shapes sections render live under --engine blinkless: named flows move content between boxes on the one canvas, exclusions reshape the lines beside a box, and shape-inside narrows the element's own lines. The default engine parses every declaration and ignores it with graceful degrade. No property in this fixture allocates a page; paged fragmentation stays a non-goal.

Mask border: descriptor on the blend group

Rows 1-13. The frame data (source bytes, slice, width, outset, repeat, mode) rides the group and composes into a frame raster the host applies as a soft mask; the frame box shows the masked frame. The unprefixed rows render under --engine blinkless; Chrome renders the -webkit-mask-box-image family (rows 8-13, plus the shared alias longhands the class rule carries).

# Property / value What it does Effect
1 mask-border
shorthand · source slice / width / outset repeat mode
Partial: descriptor only 		Expands into the six longhands. The used frame records on the element's blend group; no border-image cells are painted.
frame data recorded
host applies the mask; nothing painted here
2 mask-border-source
none | url() | image-set() choosing url()
Partial: descriptor only 		Resolves the source bytes through the same resolver the first-wave mask uses. A gradient source stays rejected until the mask-source ledger lands.
source bytes on the group
3 mask-border-slice
1-4 numbers or percentages, optional fill
Partial: descriptor only 		Cuts the source into the nine-slice grid; the fill keyword also records the center cell. Insets stay in source pixels.
slice 16 with fill
4 mask-border-width
auto | 1-4 lengths or numbers
Partial: descriptor only 		Frame thickness in points on the descriptor. Percentage widths are rejected because the descriptor is written before the element box exists.
width 14px = 10.5pt
5 mask-border-outset
1-4 lengths or numbers
Partial: descriptor only 		Expands the frame outward from the border box; recorded in points, like the border-image arithmetic it copies.
outset 0 (frame at the border box)
6 mask-border-repeat
stretch | repeat | round | space, 1-2 values
Partial: descriptor only 		Stores the repeat pair as a token; the host decides how to tile the frame.
repeat tiles the frame band

alpha | luminance, initial alpha
Partial: descriptor only 		Stores the mode token; it is not baked into the bytes unless the first-wave SVG mask path already preprocessed them.
mode alpha

Partial: descriptor only 		Normalizes onto the standard shorthand; source order against the standard name follows the cascade.

Regions: named flow, tolerance, and wrap breaks

Rows 14-22. Named flows move content between boxes on the one canvas; exclusions reshape later lines; wrap breaks move line and flex geometry. No row allocates a page.

# Property / value What it does Effect (live)
14 flow-into
none | <custom-ident> [element | content]
Implemented: one canvas 		Names the element's content (or the element itself with the element keyword). The children leave normal flow and wait for a region.
source, flow-into: article content
named flow words
region, flow-from: article
the words paint inside the right box
15 flow-from
none | <custom-ident>
Implemented: one canvas 		Makes the element a region box that adopts the named flow's content and does not paint its own children.
source
adopted words
region, flow-from: story
source box stays empty; region carries the words
16 region-fragment
auto | break
Implemented: one canvas 		auto lets one child start in a region and continue in the next; break moves the whole child to the next region when it does not fit.
region 1
region 2, same flow
break keeps a whole child on one region box
17 flow-tolerance
normal | <length> | infinite, initial normal
Implemented: masonry only 		Masonry packing slack: normal is one em, a length is points, infinite keeps the shortest-column choice. Non-masonry grids ignore it.
a
b
infinite: b packs under a in column 1
18 wrap-flow
auto | both | start | end | minimum | maximum | clear
Implemented: one canvas 		Turns a sized box into an exclusion that pushes later lines aside; auto means no exclusion.
exclusion box
following lines shorten on both sides
19 wrap-through
wrap | none, initial wrap
Implemented: one canvas 		none lets an element's lines use the full content width even when an earlier exclusion overlaps them.
exclusion
wrap-through: none ignores this exclusion
20 wrap-before
auto | line | avoid | avoid-line | flex | avoid-flex
Implemented: line/flex 		line forces a break before the element; avoid skips a soft wrap within one em of slack; flex starts a new flex line.
line one forced next line
the span starts below, not inline
21 wrap-after
auto | line | avoid | avoid-line | flex | avoid-flex
Implemented: line/flex 		line forces the following text onto the next line; avoid-line glues the next word across a soft wrap within slack.
ends here text after
following text starts on the next line
22 wrap-inside
auto | avoid | avoid-line | flex | avoid-flex
Implemented: line/flex 		avoid keeps the element's text on one line when the group fits the content width; a group that fits but not the remainder moves whole to the next line.
kept together when it fits tail
the group moves as a unit, never splits mid-group

Shapes inside: line insets

Rows 23-26. shape-inside narrows the element's own lines before float exclusion runs; shape-padding shrinks that contour. The two decision-gated rows are stored no-ops.

# Property / value What it does Effect (live)
23 shape-inside
auto | outside-shape | circle() | ellipse() | inset() [ || shape-box]
Implemented: lite subset 		Tapers the element's own lines inside a circle, ellipse, or inset. Needs a definite content height; auto-height boxes stay full width.
inside lines narrow toward the middle of the box and widen again at the bottom, following the circle contour declared on this element.
middle lines are shorter than the first line
24 shape-padding
<length-percentage>, non-negative
Implemented: with shape-inside 		Shrinks the inside contour before it narrows the lines; a padding larger than the shape yields zero-width lines, never a page break.
the same circle with 10px of shape padding cuts the lines earlier, so each middle line is shorter than the same box without padding.
padding 10px versus the row above
25 shape-image-threshold
decision gate: no url() image shapes
Stored no-op 		Kept unsupported: the shape-outside subset rejects url(), so there is no image contour to threshold. The recorded decision is not to add image shapes here.
this element declares the threshold; lines stay full width because no image shape exists in this engine.
declared and ignored, no crash
26 float-defer
<integer> | last | none, decision gate
Stored no-op 		Kept unsupported beyond the initial none: there is no page-float model, and the recorded decision is not to invent page boxes for it.
this element declares float-defer; the float behavior stays the initial none because the decision kept integer and last unsupported.
declared and ignored, no crash
v0.0.3 ledgers: plans/v0.0.3/mask-border, plans/v0.0.3/regions, plans/v0.0.3/shapes. The mask-border rows are Partial by design (the host applies the frame); the regions and shapes rows are the one-canvas contract. Paged fragmentation stays a non-goal in every row.
